tone_and_voice.visual_metaphor: A modern cockpit for a Linux spaceship. Think 'Ubuntu Touch meets Cyberpunk 2077'.

scale.code: text-sm font-mono bg-black/30 p-1 rounded text-orange-400

usage_rules.gradients: Use subtle vertical gradients for backgrounds: 'bg-gradient-to-b from-[#2C001E] to-[#1A1618]'.
usage_rules.borders: 1px solid border-white/10 for cards. border-orange-500/50 for active states.

layout_strategy.spacing_scale: Relaxed spacing (p-6, p-8) for dashboard cards, Tight spacing (p-2) for terminal lines.

Button.default: bg-primary text-white rounded hover:bg-orange-600 transition-all font-ubuntu font-medium px-6 py-2 shadow-lg hover:shadow-orange-500/20
Button.outline: border border-white/20 hover:bg-white/5 text-white rounded px-6 py-2

Card.base: bg-surface/50 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/5 rounded-xl p-6 hover:border-white/10 transition-colors

Input.base: bg-black/20 border border-white/10 rounded focus:border-orange-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-orange-500 text-white placeholder:text-white/30 font-mono

Terminal.wrapper: bg-terminal_bg border-t border-white/10 font-mono text-sm p-4 h-64 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar

Badge.base: px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider

visual_enhancers.texture: Add a subtle 'noise' overlay to the main background to reduce digital banding and add an analog feel.
visual_enhancers.glow: Use drop-shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(233,84,32,0.3)] for active elements (The Ubuntu Glow).

hero_background.usage: Use as a subtle background pattern with low opacity (10%) and blend-mode-overlay.

android_device.usage: Use in the 'Device Connection' panel to represent the hardware interface.

instructions_to_main_agent: 2. THEME: Apply the dark Aubergine theme globally in index.css. Do not use standard Tailwind grays; use the specific hex codes provided.
3. LAYOUT: Create a persistent 'Terminal Drawer' at the bottom of the screen that can be toggled (expanded/collapsed).
4. DASHBOARD: Implement a Bento Grid for the dashboard. Card 1: Connected Device (Large). Card 2: Build Status (Medium). Card 3: Recent Logs (Tall).
5. AI INTEGRATION: The AI chat interface should look like a chat bubbles BUT styled as code comments (gray text, monospaced font) to fit the developer aesthetic.
6. SKEUOMORPHISM: Add subtle 1px inner borders to cards to mimic 'etched glass' or 'machined metal'.
7. PROGRESS: Use block-based progress bars (e.g., [||||||....]) alongside standard smooth bars.
8. NOSTALGIA: Use the Ubuntu Orange (#E95420) for all primary actions and 'active' states. It is the signature color.
universal_guidelines: Avoid 'AI slop' design - no generic gradients or rounded colorful blobs.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
Use 'react-resizable-panels' if possible for the terminal/dashboard split.
